comment: Independent hack.c witness for moving into a safe pet that is inside a wall: the debug dwarven Archeologist creates a tame xorn, which appears on an adjacent wall square, and steps into it. uhitm.c do_attack() draws its rn2(7) displacement roll and lets the step through, and test_move()'s obstacle arm returns FALSE for a hero who cannot pass walls, so domove_core() stops silently without spending the turn; she then searches once. I chose seed 9920010 from a scan of 9920001-9920059 that read the xorn's square from the C screens; 17 starts put it in a wall, and this one does not stop on the rn2(7) roll.
